chapter: Other drummers and New Orleans musicians
title: The Matthews drummers and Ramos
summary: He heard Bill Matthews on the street and played bass drum with Ramos.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Now, if you could ask him more about the other drummers, I don't know who you've talked about, but what about the Matthew boys, how many of those did you hear?
Bill Matthews? Well, I heard Bill a couple of times play drum on the street.
He played last year, I think he played Isidore Barbera. Paul's father, you know when he died, he played this funeral on drums, didn't he?
I believe so, I'm not sure. Yeah, pretty sure.
I think I might some mind said he played drums.
He was down with Eureka at the Armistice Day one time at Chalmette.
I was wondering, you know, also about Ramis and Bebe.

Well, I played bass drum with Ramis. Ramis played snare drum and I played bass drum with them already. But I never played, I wasn't playing when Bill was playing drums, snare drum when he was playing drums. I wasn't playing.
